command.setCredentials: EWW Bridge: Set Feishu App Credentials
command.followLatestSession: EWW Bridge: Follow Latest Session (use when a new chat does not sync)
command.injectTest: EWW Bridge: Simulate Feishu Message (Inject into Current Session)
command.patchCopilotFlush: EWW Bridge: Patch Built-in Copilot for Immediate Flush (Recommended)
command.restoreCopilotFlush: EWW Bridge: Restore Built-in Copilot Flush Patch
command.compatCheck: EWW Bridge: Compatibility Self-Check (after a VS Code upgrade)
config.copilotExtensionFile: Path to the built-in Copilot `extension.js` (leave empty to auto-detect). Set it manually only when auto-detection fails or the patch anchor does not match.
config.enabled: Enable the bridge (Feishu connects only after the App ID/Secret are configured).
config.feishu.appId: Feishu self-built app App ID (the App Secret is written to SecretStorage by a command).
config.feishu.defaultChatId: Target Feishu chat id (starts with `oc_`). Leave empty to remember the chat after the first allow-listed inbound message.
config.forward.userMessages: Mirror prompts you send in VS Code to Feishu.
config.forward.assistantMessages: Mirror the assistant's final answer to Feishu.
config.forward.toolCalls: Attach a summary of tool calls to the answer.
config.forward.progress: Show a compact activity line (e.g. editing a file) instead of code content.
config.forward.thinking: Mirror the reasoning process (off by default to keep cards small and updates fast).
config.forward.streaming: Real-time output: send a placeholder card first, then keep updating the same card with thinking/tool/answer deltas.
config.forward.streamingIntervalMs: Minimum interval between card updates (ms). Smaller is more real-time; too small may hit Feishu rate limits.
config.forward.patchStreamText: Prepend answer text from the chatSessions patch stream (only when the card already has text with a matching prefix). Disable to turn this off.
config.forward.idleMs: How many milliseconds of silence mark a turn as finished and trigger a push.
config.security.allowedOpenIds: Allow-listed Feishu `open_id`s that may send tasks. When empty, every inbound message is rejected and the sender's `open_id` is echoed back.
config.security.prefix: Inbound command prefix (e.g. `#ai`). Leave empty to require no prefix; the allowlist still applies.
config.inject.newChat: `true`: start a new chat for every Feishu task. `false`: append to the current chat.
config.inject.timeoutMs: Maximum time (ms) to wait for one task to finish; the queue continues afterwards.
